meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打磨界面细节,让组件、动效与交互手感更自然精致
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正为产品的界面细节和交互质感反复推敲
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep refining your product's interface details and interaction feel

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 Emil Kowalski 的设计工程理念帮你做和审 UI：判断某处该不该动效、选缓动曲线与时长，并处理按钮按压反馈、popover 原点、tooltip 延迟等组件细节；审查界面代码时固定用 Before/After/Why 的 markdown 表格输出。
howto.when: 当你要求做 UI 打磨、组件设计或动效决策，或让 Claude 审查前端界面代码时接管。若首次调用时你还没提出具体问题，它只回一句准备好的话，不展开其他内容。

say.text: 这个下拉菜单的动画该怎么调？
say.note: 它会给出缓动曲线和时长建议

say.text: 审查这段按钮代码，用 Before/After 表格给我
这个弹窗到底该不该加动画？
say.note: 按用户看到它的频率给决策

howto.what_en: Claude applies Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy to UI work: whether to animate, which easing and duration, and details like press feedback and popover origins. UI reviews come back as a Before/After/Why table.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for UI polish, component design, or animation decisions, or ask Claude to review front-end interface code. Invoked with no question, it first replies with a single readiness line.

say_en.text: How should I tune the animation on this dropdown?
Review this button code; give me a Before/After table
say_en.note: Lists each fix and the reason

say_en.text: Should this modal animate at all?
say_en.note: Answers by how often users see it
